scope_rule: Reviewed operation semantics and bounded native captures, not a complete service operation inventory or a support claim. The generated service inventory records the chosen-service operation target.

primary_revision.revision: AWS latest published documentation; API reference publication date recorded below, no immutable commit supplied

evidence_contract.observations: Ordered case/operation/parameters plus native code/output or error and HTTP/request ID when raw signed transport is used.
evidence_contract.secrets: Authorization tokens, passwords, credentials and presigned layer URLs are never retained. Upload IDs and digests are nonsecret.
evidence_contract.cleanup: Each capture retains owned resource names and observed deletion/not-found outcomes; KMS pending deletion is not immediate physical removal.

semantics: Project retains source, environment, role, artifact/cache/log settings and regional/account identity. Updating rejected fields must preserve prior state.
Source retrieval, role assumption and artifact/log delivery use owning AWS services rather than parallel stores.
Name-scoped probes never enumerate standing projects. ListProjects pagination/sort needs separate behavioral evidence.
StartBuild accepts asynchronous execution, not success. Actual commands establish succeeded/failed/stopped/timed-out status, phase contexts, timestamps and buildComplete.
Start overrides apply to one build only; environment precedence is start override > project > buildspec.
StartBuild idempotency token is case-sensitive and valid five minutes; same token with changed parameters is a mismatch.
Buildspec 0.2 preserves shell state; 0.1 executes commands separately. Finally runs after failed commands. UPLOAD_ARTIFACTS is always attempted even when BUILD fails.
StopBuild attempts cancellation; observe terminal state, do not treat request acceptance as completed cancellation.
Curated CodeBuild images use CODEBUILD pull credentials; cross-account/private images require SERVICE_ROLE.
Build history and partial batch deletion failures are real state, not a list of projects. Build deletion does not delete S3 artifacts or CloudWatch logs.
Owned probes query only the owned project history; account-wide build enumeration is not needed.
Reserved fleets provision real dedicated capacity and keep charging while idle; configuration metadata alone is not a fleet.
No native fleet created under the one-dollar bound; fleet Create/Delete/List remain part of the sixteen-operation target.
BatchGetFleets and UpdateFleet are outside coverage target but real consumers may require them.
Source credentials configure authenticated external source access; tokens must not appear in returned metadata/logs/fixtures.
No external source secrets imported and no standing credential configuration changed; these enterprise operations remain unproven by native captures.

ImportSourceCredentials OAUTH is console-only, not supported through the API. shouldOverwrite defaults true. token contains a connectionArn or secretArn for CODECONNECTIONS and SECRETS_MANAGER respectively.
